title: Officers keep saying 'don't worry about Michael Johnson'
place_text: Ellsworth Air Force Base, South Dakota

tellings.quote: some more and every time I ask about Michael Johnson they tell they kept telling me don't worry about Michael Johnson he's fine he's

plain: In 1977 at Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, every time he asked about a fellow guard named Michael Johnson, officers kept telling him "don't worry about Michael Johnson, he's fine." Mario Woods, who guarded nuclear weapons there and says he was abducted, tells Michels this himself, naming a Colonel Spraker among the officers, and the repeated brush-off suggests something was being kept from him.
